meta.name: design-dna
meta.description: Extract, define, and apply design DNA across three dimensions: design system (tokens), design style (qualitative feel), and visual effects (Canvas, WebGL, 3D, particles, shaders, scroll effects, etc.). Use this skill when: (1) a user wants to see the full 3-dimension design structure/schema, (2) a user provides images, screenshots, or URLs of reference designs and wants them analyzed into a structured JSON profile covering all three dimensions, (3) a user has a Design DNA JSON and content and wants a design generated from it, or (4) any combination of these phases. Triggers on "design DNA", "extract design style", "analyze design", "design tokens from reference", "generate design from JSON", "design system from screenshot", "design profile", "style guide JSON", "visual effects analysis", "design with effects", "3d design analysis".

copy.tagline: 提取、定义并应用设计DNA，涵盖设计系统、风格与视觉效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从参考设计中提取结构化设计规范并生成新设计
copy.tagline_en: Extract, define, and apply design DNA across design system, style, and visual effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract structured design specs from references and generate new designs

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你给的参考图或链接，提取出设计系统（颜色、字体等）、设计风格（氛围、个性）和视觉效果（3D、粒子等）三方面的信息，并生成一份结构化的 JSON 设计档案。之后还能用这份档案为你生成对应的网页设计。
howto.when: 当你提到“设计DNA”、“分析设计”、“从参考提取设计令牌”等关键词，或者直接提供图片、截图、链接要求分析设计时触发。

say.text: 用这个设计DNA JSON生成一个着陆页
展示设计结构的完整模式
say.note: Claude 会输出设计DNA的三维结构说明。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can extract design system tokens, style feel, and visual effects from reference images/links, output a structured JSON profile, and later generate a design from that profile.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "design DNA", "analyze design", "extract design style", etc., or provide images/screenshots/URLs for design analysis.

say_en.text: Analyze this screenshot for design DNA.
say_en.note: Claude extracts colors, fonts, style, etc., and outputs a JSON profile.

say_en.text: Generate a landing page from this design DNA JSON.
say_en.note: You need to provide a design DNA JSON first.

say_en.text: Show me the full design structure schema.
say_en.note: Claude outputs the three-dimensional design structure.
